patch.summary:
Choose Genesys only if your buying job matches “Enterprise CCaaS (Genesys Cloud CX) — CX 1 from $75/user/mo annual; CX 2 $115; CX 3 $155; ” rather than Zoom's shape. Choose Zoom only if your buying job matches “Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floo” rather than Genesys's shape. Workflow advantage: Genesys leans contact-center, customer-messaging; Zoom leans business-phone, team-communication. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Genesys is Enterprise CCaaS (Genesys Cloud CX) — CX 1 from $75/user/mo annual; CX 2 $115; CX 3 $155; CX 4 $240.; Zoom is Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floor ~$15–16/user/month; free meetings/chat exist but.
- Company-size focus: Genesys (mid-market, enterprise) vs Zoom (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Genesys-leaning contact-center, customer-messaging, sales-calling vs Zoom-leaning business-phone, team-communication.
- Researched limits: Genesys — Enterprise complexity and implementation cost — not an SMB self-serve phone; Zoom — Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service.

Limitations — Genesys: Enterprise complexity and implementation cost — not an SMB self-serve phone; CX 1 is voice-only; digital channels require CX 2 or digital add-ons; Zoom: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service; Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive.

Poor-fit cases: Genesys is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Enterprise complexity and implementation cost — not an SMB self-serve phone · Zoom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service · Avoid Genesys if you actually need Zoom's motion (Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited res)
